# Spinner

<!-- Generated by `pnpm readme:build`. Edit only inside the hand-written block. -->

media and display · tier 1 · beta · renders on the server and ships no client JavaScript.

<!-- hand-written -->

## When to use

For a wait of unknown length: a route still loading, a preview still building. When the
shape of what is coming is known, a list or a table among them, a Skeleton holds its place
instead.

```tsx
<Spinner />
<div className="flex items-center gap-3">
  <Spinner size="lg" aria-hidden />
  <p className="text-muted">Building your preview</p>
</div>
```

A spinner is an icon, so it takes the icon scale, 16 to 40 px, and `size="custom"` leaves it
at 1em to follow the text around it. It is named but silent: an image called
`labels.common.loading`, or your own `aria-label`, with no live region. Beside text that
already names the wait, pass `aria-hidden`; to take the colour of that text instead of a
tone, pass `className="text-current"`. In forced colors it takes the system text colour
of its parent, so it stays visible in Windows high contrast.

<!-- /hand-written -->

## Import

```tsx
import { Spinner } from 'topclassui/spinner'
```

## Props

Every prop below is optional and falls back to the default shown.

| Prop | Required | Type | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `labels` | no | `Labels` | - | The built-in strings; the accessible name is `labels.common.loading`. Defaults to English. |
| `locale` | no | `string` | - | Accepted so `{...getLabels(locale)}` spreads cleanly. Nothing here formats a number, so it is not used and never reaches the element. |
| `size` | no | `xs` \| `sm` \| `md` \| `lg` \| `xl` \| `custom` | `"md"` | The icon scale, 16 to 40 px; custom sets no size, so it follows the text at 1em. |
| `tone` | no | `primary` \| `neutral` \| `success` \| `warning` \| `danger` \| `info` | `"primary"` | The colour ramp it draws in; className="text-current" takes the text colour instead. |

Anything else is passed to the root element, so standard attributes (`onClick`, `aria-*`, `data-*`, `id`) work. `className` is merged last, so yours wins a conflict, and `ref` is a normal prop.
